items.question: Can I flip the N200k account to N1M before withdrawing?
items.answer: Lai-Lai. The max profit you can hold is 50% (N100k). Once you hit that N300k total equity, trading pauses. You collect your N70k (70%) and we reset. We want consistent cashouts, not one-time gambling luck.

items.question: Can I use Bots or EAs?
items.answer: Yes, Boss. Bring your robot, bring your EA. As long as the bot respects the 240-second rule and doesn't scalp tick-by-tick, we are good. If your bot malfunctions and blows the account, na you and your coder get that problem.

items.question: Is there a Daily Loss Limit?
items.answer: No. We don commot the chain. You fit lose 5% today and recover am tomorrow. As long as you don't hit the total High Water Mark (The Red Line), you are still in the game.

items.question: Why did my account disappear?
items.answer: You likely violated the 48-Hour Rule. If you sleep on the bicycle, the bicycle goes. We run a tight ship; inactivity is not an option.

items.question: What if I blow the account, Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Funny you. This is a test of skill. If you blow, take your "Breakfast" in peace and try again. No refunds, no stories.

items.question: When can I request payouts?
items.answer: After achieving a minimum of 10% net profit. The payout process is initiated within 24 hours of your request.
